q: Is it safe on all fabrics?
a: It's designed for everyday cottons, blends and synthetics. As with any fabric product, test a small hidden area first on delicate, silk or dry-clean-only items. For use on fabrics and clothing only — not for application to skin.
No. ODORSTRIKE extends the time between washes and refreshes clothes you want to re-wear — it does not clean them. Always launder heavily soiled or stained garments normally.

q: How long does a 50ml bottle last?
a: Roughly 250 sprays. For most people using a few sprays per wear, a bottle lasts several weeks to a couple of months depending on how often you use it.
Hold the bottle ~15cm from the fabric, mist lightly over the areas that hold odor (collar, underarms, back), and let it dry for a few seconds before wearing. A little goes a long way.
